name: LEGO Botanicals Mini Orchid

image.alt: LEGO orchid with peach flowers, dark-green leaves, a light-terracotta pot, and a brown wood-effect plinth.

cardLine: A miniature orchid to build, then make part of your desk display.
description: The LEGO Botanicals Mini Orchid is a 274-piece, brick-built flower display with five peach blooms and dark-green leaves. A light-terracotta pot with a gold-colored band sits on a separate brown wood-effect plinth, bringing the finished build into desk or shelf decor.
whyWePicked: The building experience is part of the gift, while the peach blooms and detailed pot give the finished piece a display role.
